text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Y-you all right there? You're seriously not cut out for this horror stuff. I know you're trying to be brave and all, but isn't this just makin' things worse?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I, I'm okay… I'll do my best! You two have gone out of your way to help me… I don't want that to go to waste!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's gooo! You good to bring on the spooks?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll overcome my fears in time for the Solefall Faire, and then I can guide guests the Demonic Castle!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Aaaagh! O-over theeere! Something passed by, didn't it?! Did you see it?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: It disappeared into the shadow behind the shelf! If, if we get close, it's going to attack us!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whoa, girl, there's nothing there! Gasp! Doto, I just got it! You must have, like, a super active imagination, right?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, s-sorry about that… Uuugh, I won't be able to guide the guests like this…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I don't think that's true. Since you know how it feels to be scared and all, you'd be great with the guests who don't like horror.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: For real, like I bet they'd be so relieved someone gets them, y'know what I mean?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: …Y-you really think so?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Of course! So this time, don't think too hard about the spooks and just stay in the moment!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: You know, just go with the vibes and keep 'em popping! 'Kay? Wahey!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: W-wahey!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Waheeey! That zombie's face is straight up busted! Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What's with the F-tier piano music? I can't vibe to this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Come on! Show 'em what you've got, Doto! ♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Waaagh?! I-I mean, wind, wind, go a-waheeey!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Whooooaaa?! The window! It's… busting?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Waheeey! ♪ Hey, Doto! You good to do the guidin' thing now?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Waheeey! Maybe?! I'll give it a g-go. Woohooo!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I sense major vibes ahead! Everyone, b-b-be careful… For real, for real!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oooooh! Doto, you're gettin' the hang of it! Your energy's contagious!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Doto, check out that werewolf! Hahaha, look how huge bro's teeth are! I can't! ☆

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: B-big yikes… am I right?! Brushing them is giving… difficult vibes!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Pfft! That's your takeaway? I'm dead!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ehehe… me too! I'm, uh, undead!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: …Wait, it's bright over there! Have we found the exit? That's craaazy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wanna end off on a high note?! Let's get outta here together!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: And we're… freeeee! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! That was peak! ♪ What did you think, Doto?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah! I had a great time! We had so much fun, I completely forgot to be scared!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Big character moment for Doto! ☆ Haunted houses should be a piece of cake for you now, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I do feel more confident. I think I can guide the guests through the lair without getting scared!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Solefall Faire. I hear there's a haunted house attraction, so I go to have a look.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Look, it's a big success!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: So like, why don't you get in on the fun?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, it's a phrase that gives me courage!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, guest alert! We've got major good vibes here at the Demonic Castle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Meisho Doto super confident in her role, the haunted house attraction is a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh… Trainer! All we need is a few more guests to reach a hundred!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: …All right! I'm going to do my best to call some more over!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: We've o-opened a haunted house! It's the Demonic Castle!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Sc-scaredy-cats can join in on the fun! Because I'm leading the way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto beckons the passersby over. The number of guests increases thanks to her fervent advertising!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. Welcomb to the Debomic Hassle. Come on i-in…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: …Ohhh, I'm not pronouncing it properly. I'm not supposed to be scared anymore…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: …Oh, hello there! Come on… on… on…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Come on i-i-in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto does her utmost best to guide the customers, despite slipping on her words!
